languageModel.name: qwen3.5:9b
languageModel.argument: The sentence begins with a sequence of four parenthetical groups joined by 'or', followed by several text conditions also joined by 'or'. According to the CTDL definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition, this structure represents a context where more than one alternative path fulfills the parent condition, mapping to an 'any_of' node. The first four items are parenthetical groups containing course codes joined by 'and'. Per the rule that brackets group items and courses joined by 'and' inside brackets form an 'all_of', these map to 'all_of' nodes. The remaining items ('MATH 11003 or higher', etc.) are not enclosed in brackets joining multiple courses with 'and', so they are treated as individual text conditions under the main 'any_of' node.
